name: Evangelism
overview: Scripture clearly commands believers to actively proclaim the gospel, emphasizing the urgency and vast opportunity for evangelism as the harvest is plentiful but laborers are few (Matthew 9:37). Followers of Christ are empowered by the Holy Spirit to be witnesses locally and globally, tasked to make disciples of all nations through preaching and baptism (Acts 1:8; Matthew 28:19; Mark 16:15). The gospel is the powerful means of salvation for all who believe, and believers are called to boldly share this message without shame (Romans 1:16). This calling includes giving thanks, calling on the Lord’s name, and making known His deeds among the people (Psalms 105:1).
